CADENCE ships a single-thread FFmpeg WebAssembly core built from:

- FFmpeg n5.1.4 (LGPL-2.1-or-later)
  https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/releases/tag/n5.1.4
- ffmpeg.wasm v0.12.10 glue (bindings MIT, fftools under FFmpeg's LGPL)
  https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v0.12.10
- Emscripten 3.1.40

Configure flags include --disable-gpl, --disable-nonfree, and --disable-postproc.
No GPL libraries are linked (no libx264, libx265, libxvid, or libpostproc).
The only encoder is pcm_s16le and the only muxer is WAV.

The native H.264 decoder still contains the words "x264" in SEI messages and
codec fourccs. That is not the GPL libx264 encoder, which is not linked.

Rebuild with scripts/build-ffmpeg-lgpl.sh. The license text is COPYING.LGPLv2.1.
